name: Cal Raleigh
headline: Raleigh scratched vs. KC with soreness; day-to-day
summary: Cal Raleigh was scratched before Saturday's game against Kansas City with general soreness requiring imaging. Mariners lost 3-2 in extra innings. Listed day-to-day.

name: Bryce Harper
headline: Harper 0-for-3 in Phillies' 4-0 loss at Miami
summary: Harper went hitless in 3 at-bats as Andrew Painter outpitched the Phillies in Miami. Philadelphia drops the series opener.

name: Luis Arraez
headline: Arraez 3-for-4 with double; batting .317 on season
summary: Arraez had 3 hits including a double and scored a run in 4 at-bats. Giants lost to Tampa Bay despite his performance.

name: Bo Bichette
headline: Bichette 1-for-4 in Mets' 4-3 loss at Anaheim
summary: Bichette went 1-for-4 as the Mets dropped a 4-3 decision to the Angels. Batting .231 on the season.

name: Lindor/McGonigle
headline: McGonigle RBI single, stolen base; Tigers win 5-1
summary: Kevin McGonigle drove in a run with a single and stole a base in the 2nd inning as Detroit beat Texas 5-1. Kumar Rocker (TEX) took the loss.

name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
headline: PCA 0-for-3 as Imanaga gems Cubs past D-backs 2-0
summary: Crow-Armstrong went hitless in 3 at-bats but drew a walk. Shota Imanaga tossed 7 shutout innings as Chicago blanked Arizona 2-0.

name: Jackson Merrill
headline: Merrill 1-for-4 as Padres shut out 4-0 by White Sox
summary: Merrill's infield single in the 9th was one of just 4 Padres hits. San Diego blanked 4-0 in their 4th straight loss.

name: Teoscar Hernandez
headline: Hernandez 2-for-4 as Dodgers fall 3-2 to Cardinals
summary: Hernandez went 2-for-4 with singles in the 7th and 9th innings as St. Louis earned their 6th straight win, 3-2.

name: Devin Williams
headline: Williams DNP; Mets lose 4-3 in Anaheim
summary: Williams did not appear as the Mets dropped a 4-3 decision to the Angels. ERA stands at 7.20 through 12 appearances this season.

name: Zack Wheeler
headline: Wheeler off turn; started May 1 vs. Marlins (PHI won)
summary: Wheeler is off turn for May 2. He started the series opener May 1 in Miami (Phillies won). Currently 2-0 with a 2.65 ERA through 3 starts (17 IP).

name: Cole Ragans
headline: Ragans off turn; started May 1 at Seattle — ERA rises to 5.44
summary: Ragans went 5⅓ innings with 4 ER and 8 Ks at Seattle on May 1. KC won 7-6 on Lane Thomas' walk-off. ERA climbs to 5.44 through 8 GS.

name: Chase Burns
headline: Burns off turn; scheduled to start May 3 vs. Pittsburgh
summary: Burns is lined up for Sunday at home vs. the Pirates. He's 3-1 with a 2.65 ERA through 6 starts this season.

name: Nathan Eovaldi
headline: Eovaldi off turn; Rangers lose 5-1 at Detroit
summary: Eovaldi did not pitch Friday as Kumar Rocker started for Texas. Rangers lost 5-1 at Detroit. Eovaldi is 3-1 with a 4.76 ERA through 7 starts.

name: Emmet Sheehan
headline: Sheehan off turn; rough May 1 start at STL (balk, 4 ER)
summary: Sheehan started Thursday night at St. Louis, balking in the first inning, and allowed 4 ER in 4⅔ innings (8 K). ERA now 5.55 through 7 starts.

name: Reid Detmers
headline: Detmers 6⅓ IP, 8 K, W — Angels beat Mets 4-3
summary: Detmers turned in a strong outing — 6⅓ innings, 7 H, 3 ER, 8 K, 2 BB — as the Angels won 4-3. Improves to 2-1 with a 4.28 ERA.

name: Giancarlo Stanton
headline: Stanton (IL-10, calf) taking cage swings; return still weeks away
summary: Stanton was placed on the 10-day IL on April 23 with a right calf strain. He took his first batting cage swings May 1, but return is still weeks away.
